source_review_notes.provider_fields: Supplier name/URL/key are editable unless busy in providers.rs. Subdued idle presentation is not a read-only contract; read-only is applicable to terminal logs, not these fields.
source_review_notes.model_selection: Models::render_tr already sets AccessKit selected; accesskit_consumer is_item_like excludes Row so macOS adapter suppresses native selected. Candidate adds full row identity and selection wording, retaining native table/row/cell and selected metadata.
source_review_notes.dialog: Kit owns focus trap and dismissal. Candidate names its application body Dialog and sets modal; native CUA cannot attest modal flag or true AT behavior.
